summary: Bitzero Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting its approval for listing on Nasdaq under ticker AIBZ, with trading expected to commence June 9, 2026. The board chair stepped down, and CEO Mohammed Bakhashwain became chair; two new independent directors were appointed. No acquisition, spin-off, tender, or other special-situation transaction is described. This is a routine listing milestone and board transition, not a special situation.
